name: getchalk
description: The Claude Code plugin for Chalk: point at what Claude Code got wrong, on a screenshot of your app. Requires the free, open-source Chalk app for macOS (github.com/ubmids/chalk).

plugins.name: chalk-board
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to Chalk: Claude shows what it built on a board beside your terminal, you circle what's wrong, it fixes that spot. Requires the free, open-source Chalk app for macOS 13 or newer (github.com/ubmids/chalk).
